canada-student-visa-guide.title: Guía del Visado de Estudiante para Canadá
canada-student-visa-guide.excerpt: Todo lo que necesitas saber antes de solicitar un permiso de estudios en Canadá.
content: Canada has become one of the world's leading destinations for international students due to its high-quality education system, multicultural society, and excellent post-graduation opportunities.

Before applying for a Canadian Study Permit, students must first receive a Letter of Acceptance from a Designated Learning Institution (DLI). This document confirms that the institution has accepted your application.

Applicants must also demonstrate sufficient financial resources to cover tuition, living expenses, and transportation during their stay in Canada. Immigration officers will carefully review your financial documentation.

Many international students may work while studying, provided they meet the conditions of their study permit. After graduation, some students may also qualify for a Post-Graduation Work Permit, which can provide valuable Canadian work experience.
Because immigration policies may change over time, it is important to verify current requirements before submitting an application or seek professional guidance when needed.
